instruction: Import seed_ss_gui_16_handle.dxf from /home/user/Desktop with File > Import, then continue editing that imported drawing rather than starting from an empty document in SolveSpace. Launch SolveSpace from `/usr/bin/solvespace` before importing `seed_ss_gui_16_handle.dxf`. Do not use File > Open or launch the DXF as a native SolveSpace file. All dimensions and coordinates below are in millimeters (mm). Use the existing end guides, tangent lines, and internal-opening guide to create the final handle-shaped outer outline with overall size 160 x 50, a semicircle of radius 25 at each left and right end, and top/bottom horizontal tangent lines between them. Add one centered internal opening of 100 x 14. Add four diameter 6 mounting holes at (40,10), (120,10), (40,40), and (120,40). Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. When the geometry is complete, align the view to the active workplane if needed, then use File > Export 2d View, choose the DXF file type, and save the result as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_16.dxf. Do not use File > Save As for this final DXF export.
